$comment: Claude Code settings for VSift agent trials (P12, ADR 0022 decision 7). The harness copies this file into each trial workspace as .claude/settings.json, the only source of the trial's rules: run marks that workspace as trusted in the client home (Claude Code ignores a project's allow rules in an untrusted workspace) and starts Claude Code with --setting-sources project and --permission-mode dontAsk, which denies every tool use outside the allow list without prompting (commands Claude Code classes as read-only still run). Relative patterns resolve against the trial workspace, which holds the skill and VSift's session root. The grader enforces the command policy independently of these rules.
